bead.title: CL-008 Publish post-cleanup rename-surface count
bead.description: After cleanup deletes land, measure the remaining rename surface so Fizeau beads operate on the smallest practical set of files.
bead.acceptance: A docs/research note records counts for old module path, package agent at root, ddx-agent, DDX Agent/DDx Agent, .agent, AGENT_*, DDX_AGENT_* and compares them to the pre-cleanup baseline.
